reviews.review_description: Brad from Solar my House presented their product options in a professional manner with a 'facts only' presentation. The installation team were punctual, and professional with a sound knowledge of the products and their performance. We requested a specific method of installation of the panels and our request was completed with no queries or concerns. A job well done. Thank you Brad and his team
I'd like a recommendation for a good quality inverter to replace this Chinese rubbish please and a reputable and reliable company.

We installed our solar from solar my home with 25 years warranty and itâ€™s not worth a cent. My solar stopped working all of sudden and I tried calling solar my home but there no,s are not connected and look like they have run away. I have seen a review where some one has written that Cherry Solar is owned by same owners now.Not sure what to do now and who will cover our cost or who will repair our system??

Solar My Home is now defunct and Cherry Solar are now owned and operated by the same owner. Two years ago Solar My Home installed our system with a 25yr warranty.  It was decommissioned today as being a fire hazard with warranties that are not worth the paper they are written on.  Avoid at all costs - someone will get hurt or worse.

The salesman was one of the best informed we came across. Their product seemed very good, and competitively priced. The installation was done promptly by friendly and knowledgeable tradesmen.There was a problem with one of the panels that became apparent shortly after the system was connected. I think the company is fairly small and so it was hard to schedule someone to come in to fix the problem. However, it was just a matter of timing rather than willingness to deal with it, and it was resolved after a few weeks.The system is now working, and we are very happy with it. I would certainly recommend the company.

The customer service from their sales rep, Andrew, was excellent. He knew his product and could answer any questions I had. He was always very quick to answer emails and was very helpful with arranging quick installation after signup (2 business days after signing). A couple of things they should be making prospective buyers aware of is a more accurate figure of how much energy companies charge to have your meter replaced or reconfigured (salesperson told us it would be about $65 and it was $220). The other thing that I was disappointed with was that we weren't told until after signing up that we needed a separate power point to plug the monitoring system for the micro-inverters into to set up the monitoring program on our computer. This separate power point was not offered to be put in at the time of installation (in our opinion, it should have been put in at no cost to us, as the price we paid included the monitoring system). We are currently sharing a double power point and it appears to be working, but the office have not returned our emails querying whether it is okay to be using it like this. Whilst the customer service from the sales rep and the installers was excellent, that from the office staff has been quite average. Difficult to get onto the right person or get answers to our queries and they kept sending important information to an incorrect email address, causing some delays with getting connected to the grid and getting the monitoring system up and running. No response has been received to my last email sent over a week ago. I am still happy that we went with Solar My Home and believe we got the best quality product for the price we paid. Connection to the grid was also quicker than expected - everything up and running within about 3 weeks from installation. Overall, many more positive aspects to the experience than negative. Micro-inverters certainly seem the way to go. We are producing a lot more power than I expected to in winter. Very happy to have finally gone solar!

Solar My Home came up with a clever solution that was out of the box, that their competition didn't suggest. Brad the salesman I dealt with was courteous, professional, knew his stuff and was passionate about his product.  The installation was probably larger, and more complicated than most, so we had four installers working on it who worked professionally and smoothly together.  We have had a few minor teething problems, due to the complex installation (not the products) and their after-sales customer service has been responsive and excellent.

I received 2 quotes and proceeded with the second one even though it was more expensive. The salesperson from Solar my Home convinced me that the microinverter system was a significant advance on the older technology so I decided to go ahead with that. It probably would have helped me to assess quotes if I had been aware in advance of the different technologies. After 5 weeks I am happy with the system I have
reviews.panel_brand: Not sure- I thought the whole system was enphase but that is not on the list (Other)

reviews.review_description: Once we'd paid our money after installation, (6/2/15), they dropped the ball. The girl in the office, stuffed around for a couple of weeks with finalising the required forms. We're still not sure it's finalised, (8/4/15) and we have no idea if feed-in  has been arranged yet. We've had no contact from them to see if everything's OK. We have been away for a couple of weeks, but there were no phone messages when we got back last night.
Good quality product. Clear guidance and information at time of quote.
One of the only companies that were willing to quote prior to building and their sales and support staff were fantastic in their customer focused approach.

Up to installation no issues with the Company.Post installation service poor. Definitely would not recommend Solar My Home.Problem with melted plug going into inverter 2 years after installation .Called Solar My Home and they quickly had a contractor come the next day to disconnect it.Minimal phone contact from Solar My Home to find out the progress on rectifying the problem.I had to make weekly phone calls to find this out. Took 4 and a half months of phone calls to finally get the problem sorted. Very rarely did someone from Solar My Home return my phone calls. I was told by the Director of the Company, Peter that we would be reimbursed for the 41/2 months without solar over summer months. Still waiting despite me faxing the electricity bill to the Director and him confirming that he had received it.

The salesperson was a little pushy, like this offer expires tomorrow i was told at 8pm so no chance to check other suppliers.  The installers were excellent and fully explained everything. The only thing was they didn't clean up very well as opposed to a lot of other reviews on here, left offcuts and packing material in my backyard.  But all that aside the system has performed well above my expectations and i cannot wait to see my first electricity bill.

I didn't know there was such a delay getting the system running.  The system was physically installed quite quickly (paid deposit 9 Sept, installation was 24 & 26 Sept) but I am still waiting for the system to be turned on, 10 Oct!  The installers lead me to believe it would be up and running within a few days, that is not the case. United Energy have the paperwork and I am still waiting.

The system and process was clearly explained, and the sales staff couldn't have been more helpful.I went with a micro inverter system and I am very happy with it.I have since referred the company on to family members who are considering solar

Met with sales executive Brad Townsend..a very professional presentation which left me with no doubts about installing solar.Their installation team lead by Mark was very professional.I absolutely recommend this company to anyone who intends installing solar power.

Would highly recommend SolarMyHome, we were very impressed with the standard of the install. We went with a micro inverter system with a split array as suggested by the sales person who was both knowledgeable and enthusiastic. With all the quotes I cross checked the component against the information on the SolarQuotes website and other websites and this helped us to separate the quotes. The other two companies we looked at, Gryphon Solar and the Mark Group did both offer sound competitive alternatives making the choice more difficult, but in the end we were attracted to the micro inverter system.Your website and advice was a most valuable and helped us to understand the various options and elements which make up a home solar system.Many thanks,

Very good up to payment of deposit, then a little slack answering questions. Salesman didn't want to know us after signing contract. Installation excellent, prompt with safety certificate and all paperwork.
Solar My Home were very helpful and professional in helping us make our decision. They delivered what they promised. Happy Customer!

Simon ,the sales consultant really knew his products, explained all the products and processes in detail and was not at all pushy in trying to achieve a sale. The installation crew were courteous, tidy and went to a great deal of trouble to ensure that the installation was exactly as I wanted it. Any requests for information or assistance is handled promptly and efficiently by the office staff.

We didn't really hear much for about a week then in one day we had all 3 companies give us a call. That was great. The first company came out and before the first visit I did quite a bit of research on all the companies and made my choice. Thank you Solarquotes.com.au you have made a somewhat  difficult task a breeze.

The installation was done early February and we are still 3 weeks away (latest estimate) from finalising the paperwork. Not sure what the problem was (or is) but it seems that the Electricity Provider has only been given the required information a couple of days ago. This is despite numerous phone calls and e-mails to SolarMyHome and Simply Energy.

We initially went with SolarMyHome as we connected really well with the Salesperson, who told us he was a part owner.  When we didn't hear for several weeks, we called and found out that he had left, and that he was not a part owner.  Very strange!  I was contacted by two staff, who told me the story, but we were still very nervous.  It took a call from one of their senior staff to get us to continue with them.We had our installation yesterday, and we found out some things from our installer that neither the salesperson or head office told us; we had to wait for an inspection before the system could be turned on (our salesperson told us 'It will be switched on straight away!'), we didn't know about the paperwork we had to send to the retailer, and we also didn't know that SP Ausnet had to reconfigure our meter.  The inspection and meter reconfiguring are two things that I would have thought would have been told to us straight away, not upon installation!All in all, we loved dealing with the original salesperson, but as we found out he lied and didn't tell us the full information, and the head office also didn't tell us the full story, we feel as though we got pretty sub-par service.  The system seems to be ok, but we won't know until it is inspected and switched on!  Stay tuned...

SolarMyHome offered options of product and explained the differences. I had researched product and market prior to meeting up with different companies provided by your website for information and quote of product and process.    It was not the cheapest I was looking for but the best investment possible for today.
Very happy with the service and installation. The install was done within a few weeks and done with care. Paperwork was smooth. They did a great job.

The consultant Osman Sulaiman, provided us a truly thorough insight into how to make a better decision, based on options & benefits presented to us analytically, presented proven facts and figures made available by credible independent online resources. After evaluating both system types, DC vs AC systems, we felt the natural way to go was with the microinverter system. Thank you Osman for your professional advice. We are confident these guys know the business inside out.
Best from 4 different quotations in terms of quality for price  and extent of information. Excellent customer liaison. Efficient and polite installation.
Professional approach, good advice, efficient installation, very good follow up re product recall for a PV Array DC isolator and seamless operation since installation.

The highest quality micro system at a very good price . This company came in with their  lowest  price and the best product straight off . Where other companies were only ready to  negotiate when they thought they were going  to miss out on the job . The system was installed promptly and efficiently and the installers were easy going , polite and tidy . I am very happy with my system .

Very happy with our experience, installed within in two weeks, very professional.  Within 3 weeks we were connected to the grid.  Still waiting for TDG Solar Australia to come back to us regarding login problems, sent an email 10 days ago, still no reply.In all it has been a very positive and relatively easy process for us.

Brad Townsend was excellent.We wanted to go with micro inverters and this has proven successful with our split array. 50% north, 50% eastThe advice was reliable and verifiable. The options were clear and practical.An example of putting the needs of the customer first.
I liked it that all three suppliers replied promptly to my initial query, came to talk to me and were not pushy in chasing the sale. I also liked the prompt same week installation.

After quite a number of unsuccessful enquiries, we were so pleased to find an installer which has had good experience installing on Decrabond roofing - and they did so efficiently and in just a half day.

The company salesperson was the most proficient, he inspected the roof cavity and the roof. His work on the quote was also the most easy to read and he was contactable at all times with any questions that had arisen. One salesman tried to push other products as well as solar.
I decided to get the AC system based on Finn Peacock's experience and comments about his own system he installed last year.
I was very impressed with the attention to detail by the Installers.  I couldn't fault their work.

We had a difficult installation, flat roof, use more power in winter than summer and have serious shade issues (tall trees).Brad from SolarMyHome was the only one who took the time to understand our requirements and provide the best solution.We are more than happy with the results. Even with shade our 4kW system is generating up to 24kW per day.

Solar My Home are a fantastic to do business with.The process starts with Brad coming to the home and explaining everything about Solar,Panels,Inverters,Micro-Inverters and going through our Electricity bills to make sure we got the right sized system . l researched alot and we had 10, companies quote! .Never once did Solar My Home pressure me,they were helpful and got back to me when they said they would answering all my questions.Ben and his  Team were all Polite,Tidy and even removed their boots to come inside(we don't even do that!) All the work was first class and l couldn't be happier! Brad actually climbed up our 2nd storey roof and took proper measurements! Most companies only estimate there array of panels and there placements from Google Maps!  The girls in Admin Penny and Angela are both great and guided me through the necessary forms needed to be scanned and sent to the Electricity Retailer. A 1st class Company,and a 1st class job.Michael,Bentleigh East Oct 2014.

I found it difficult to decide on which panel & inverter as different organisations seemed to prefer one or two suppliers over others.  This was compounded by one organisation who absolutely refused to deal with one type of panel which was the panel of choice for another organisation.  Further consultation with Solar Quotes helped me make my decision.

A+.Brad the Consultant is professional,knowledgeable and not pushy.He explained everything.We reviewed bills and designed a system to suit us. Brad got onto our 2nd storey roof to take proper measurements.We reviewed bills and designed a system that would give us the best outcome. Other Companies rely on Google Earth. Upon inspection we could fit 4 extra panels on the North giving  us more kilowatt production.The 2 installers and Ben the CEC accredited electrician were all great,polite,clean,friendly,took off boots to come into the house and  left NO evidence at all that they had been there spotless clean-up. Ben also set up ourWIFI MonitoringWe have the ability to view solar production from our computer or on our phones via an Ap.The Admin  girls Penny and Amanda are both lovely to deal with.'m a very happy customer and recommend the team from Solar My Home to anyone looking into installing Solar Panels,you won't be disappointed..Michael Cashmore'  Bentleigh 3165,Vic

When the system was independently inspected, the person inspecting it commented on the installer. And how they always do great work. How he liked inspecting his work, as there was usually nothing to be fixed or changed.
Installed pretty quickly, by friendly staff.

Everything went smoothly. No hitches or glitches. The slowest part was the meter switching but we knew that and it wasn't too long. Installed 29/8 and meters ready 25/9 and in the past 4 days producing 55KWh of power. Impressed

Ben the salesman was easy to get along with, no pushy sales gimmicks just the facts, office staff's communications were excellent, rang for the install date and they turned up on time with a great attitude for work, can't speak highly enough of the installer, the day was 5 degrees and blowing a gale but he just kept on working, he even went out of his way to come back another day just to show me how to run the unit. 5 stars for me.
the installation was done quickly and efficiently, and the tradesmen were polite and considerate.
Very good experience with SolarMyHome. Simon the sales consultant has excellent product knowledge and Nathan the installer wasvery good and very helpful .
Time lag between installation, inspection and connection seemed to be excessive. Salesperson from Solarmyhome was personable, knowledgeable, didn't criticise opposition and efficient.

Salesman was helpful, not aggressive (unlike some others) and courteous. Installers were very conscientious, meticulous and courteous. They were also very careful to clean up after the job (and ensure new carpet was not dirtied!) I would thoroughly recommend both the sales and installation team, and office staff who dealt with us.A thoroughly professional organisation.

I must admit that we only had the one quote but we liked what the salesman had to say and being short of time decided to go with it. Installation commenced about ten days after that and was completed in one day. I can only say what a magnificent job our two installers did on a day that was one of the coldest of the year, blowing a gale and included having panels located on two different roofs of the house. Nothing was too much trouble for them. We contacted the office on a few occasions to ask questions and all replies  were prompt and courteous. We are now connected  up to the grid and all ready to go. We were a little apprehensive about the whole thing when making our decision to install solar panels and had little real knowledge of what was involved but solar my home made it very easy for us and we are happy we chose them.
Cannot at this stage comment on value for money as it is still too early to say.

Finn, it really is a bit early to give a comprehensive review.  The system has been installed but it is not operational as yet.  There were a few hiccups with the instalation that leave me a bit "on the fence" at this stage with SMH.It would be fairer if you contacted me again a bit further down the track.

From the outset, these guys stood out.  Brad arrived on time and spent the time explaining different options to me, the other two suppliers were salesmen first, and both were late, one a little and the other a lot. When I had made the decision and had received the contract there were a couple of things I wanted clarified and rather than play email roulette, Brad rang me on a Friday evening and worked through my concerns. Amanda in the office has been great, helpful on all steps of the process, and the installers Nathan and Dylan were fantastic. On my experience I can only highly recommend this company; of course now I have to wait for the meter recalibration to actually start reaping the benefits, but that is not SolarMyHome's issue, that belongs with Origin.

Sales Rep from from SolarMyHome was very informative and helpful. However, when installers arrived they said that our switchboard would have to be upgraded before they could instal solar inverter and I had to pay an additional $60.00 cash to installer for him to proceed with installation.  During installation, 6 roofing tiles were broken and luckily I had some spare for them to replace.  Then 4 months later, water damage appeared inside plaster ceiling under solar panels and when installer was called back, another broken tile under solar panel was found and had to be replaced from my spares.  After much inconvenience and chasing around obtaining quotes from plasterers/painters, repairs should be completed at installers cost next week.

Rod from solarmyhome made the whole experience really easy. He answered all my questions professionally and politely and even gave recommendations as to which power company would give the best rates post installation. Many thanks from a very satisfied customer.

Solar My Home is a shambles - the office side of things at least.I gave them a short timeline to install and they met that.But they couldn't even spell my surname correctly on what passed as paper work.The only instruction to the installers was something like "try to fit the panels on the west facing roof. If they don't fit put remainder on north facing roof."I don't believe I have yet got a copy of was could pass for a contract from them.They delayed sending out the certificate of inspection - claimed my email address was wrong it took over a week to get the certificate from them,Solar My Home got my money, I hope the system lives up to their sales pitch, they offered nothing that resembled "service". Totally disappointed with them.Am now trapped in the "criminal" time warp where it takes my electrical distributor 40 working days to switch my solar system on to the system. So all in all not a happy solar experience.

Only received two calls from the three suppliers.  Solar my Home were prompt and efficient.  The other very slow to make an appointment to meet with us and then ended up wanting to reschedule for a much later date.  We told them to forget it!  We had done some research ourselves prior to speaking with Solar my Home and they came up with all the right answers to our questions and had a reasonable price.  They were quick to make a sales appointment, quick to schedule our system to go up and very efficient and friendly admin service.  We are now awaiting for the power company to "turn us on".

The installation was skillfully done and the installers left no mess.  They were efficient and courteous.  We needed an extra powerpoint for the Energy monitoring Unit which was the only thing not explained prior to installation.  Not an issue but we would have liked to know that you cannot have anything else on the same power socket.  Still waiting for United Energy to program the smart meter..... apparently 20-30 business days, which seems extremely slow.

Pretty good experience, fast service friendly sales people, installers tidy and efficient. On the down side they didn't seem keen to do the paperwork to get system larger than 4.6 Kw approved by SP Ausnet - suggest if you want this you should push for it.

Thanks for recommending SolarMyHome. Even though I paid cash my bank [CBA] were very interested as they get lots of requests for help in choosing a company to install panels. Some of my friends are in the process of getting solar. I like the idea of micro inverters and being able to keep a check on what is happening via the computer. It is a bit of a jungle out there when it comes to choosing a company. The bank looked up the web page of SolarMyHome and read all their testimonials.I am having trouble getting my retailer to get me on the grid. I can understand why as they are getting cheap power right now.

Pleasantly satisfied with the entire service from quotation to installation that Solar My Home executed on our system. They conduct their business very professionally at all levels from initial sales, through scheduling, installation and final inspection all expertly organized from their very capable hands-on central office function, which demonstrated an extremely effective one stop  customer interface for any issues. Would strongly recommend their service to anyone.

Initial installation date not adhered to - "did not have correct ladder" but not informed of this. Came 4 hours late on 2nd arranged day of installation - had to check if they were coming.Also error in final paperwork provided by installer for feed-in tariff application - meant application to AGL delayed and required form to be amended.Happy with system installed however and have responded to problems raised above.

One of the worst examples of customer service I have experienced.1. The job was not scoped properly by the company.  What was scheduled as one day was actually two.2. The job was booked in then postponed.  Then done on a Friday and told the guys would be back in a week or two to fiinish the job.  At one stage the ops manager advised me they may not come back for 4 weeks to complete the installation.3. Customer service and communication was terrible.4. The guys doing the actual installation were very good.5. Service and attitude of staff, particularly ops manager terrible and at times quite arrogant.6. To top it off we had a bank cheque sitting for collection when the job was completed.  They did not collect the cheque so it sat waiting for them.  They left a message for me on my phone (I was away on business and had previously asked them to contact my partner).  My wife not long after this received a message threatening legal action if payment was not received.We are not hard people to deal with.  We just expect professional behaviour and a reasonable level of customer service which on this occasion we did not receive.Unfortunately, whilst the quality of work from the tradesmen was good, we cannot recommend this business due to the poor customer service and attitude of some of the staff.I have been in the service industry for over 20 years.  I would not have staff working for me that behaved in this manner.Note: Sorry can't rate the quality of the system as yet as not operational.  This was another thing that we were not advised about until after the install. Our expectation from the sale was once installed we could use the system, not then having to apply to the local power company and wait for a month to use the equipment. We were not advised of this until after the system was installed.

Hi Finn,Just a quick note, after several months of doing my homework, (reading your page ) we signed up with Solar My Home for a 9Kw microprocessor system. It is now installed ( not yet connected to the grid ) and turned on today, currently averaging  45 Kw/day. Solar My Home has been fantastic, communicating with us regularly and their installer Paul Wells and his team from Nu Electrics were brilliant and did a great job with the installation 16 x 250w panels on tilt frames and 20 on tiles and cleaned up after themselves...would be happy to recommend to everyone.Cheers Andrew and Sue

The length of time it takes after installation to get a new meter installed (provider is allowed up to 30 days once all documents have been sent) means that you cannot use your system for a long time after installation.  This was not made clear by the sales person. My system was installed on 4 Feb and is still not usable on 3 Mar.

Hi Finn, Thank you for your great web site information, this helped me decide which invertor I wanted.  The people from solarmyhome were helpful and I was very happy with the way it was explained to me by the solarmyhome rep, I would recommend them to my friends.Regards Pauline
I will know in 12 months time how good it is. My bank is very interested in what I am doing and if I am happy with the compnay I will recommend to their customers to deal with SolarMyHome
Great service,very happy.

This is my first time buying a solar system and knew absolutely nothing about solar and what questions to ask, when I met Brad Townsend, he was very helpful and gave us lots of info. The service from start to finishwas at a high level, I have recommended SolarMyHome to a lot of my friends.
Good service and sales person was very helpful.
The job was done when promised.

For our 4.5 Kw system, we were highly impressed with the expertise of the representative who was an ex-installer.  Both the panels, Ulica, and the inverter, SMA, checked out as being good quality Tier 1.The installers from Design Electrics were unbelievably professional (and I have had experience enough to know).  Everything, including clean-up was done to perfection.  Questions were answered with expertise.All in all, a totally great experience.  We are now waiting for the combination of Energy Australia & SP AusNet to do their side of things as well.  So far, interaction with both companies over the Christmas/New Year 2014 period have been really positive.

I chose SolarMy Home because the representative explained everything to us, they are a family company.The installers were efficient and everything was left so tidy and neat,they may not have been the cheapest but we have good quality panels and Inverter etc,as they say you get what you pay for,I would recommend them to anyone.
They looked after the life saving club needs for a new inverter as well.

Clearly the most knowledgable and honest people.What ever they said would happen, happened, exactly, right down to timelines and people contacting me.  Very professional, installation a breeze, clean, tidy, helpful.

1st visit to install panels didn't work out due to direction issues and type of roof decks - anyway it ended up raining all day.Next visit when layout rearranged was all good and the installers were efficient and helpful in explaining everything.We are not yet connected to the grid as awaiting the inspector but happy so far.
SolarMyHome were extremely professional, helpful and trustworthy. We would have, absolutely, no hesitation in recommending them to any prospective customer. The installers did an awesome job too.
The installer needs to ensure the paperwork is filled out correctly and in full. Failure to do this cost me almost 2 months of solar rebates.

Solar panels didn't work when we turned them on. Very disappointing. On ringing the company they said they would come the following week. Not impressed. Only when saying we could not recommend them did they send someone out the following day.Now its all up and working and fine, no problem.
I had trouble finding out how to understand the system.  I cant seem to get anything other than an installers manual.  Customers need a user manual.I rang several times until i gave up ...

SolarMyHome were fantastic. The salesman was great: informative, not pushy and ready to answer all our questions. The installation was effortless, coordinated and fully met our expectations. The whole process ran smoothly and our system is fully operational.

In fact the inspector only came around a couple of days ago the inspect the system and all was ok.Was not happy with Powercor knocking me back on the 3 Kw system because of their transformer wasn't big enough.
Very patient salesman. No pressure applied. Good value for money.

Even though the system was installed at the end of summer I still saw a financial benefit from my very next electric bill. But the weather has been so bad and I've not had another winter bill , yet So I can't accurately say  the benefits have continued. However, the service I bought was a highly recommended system and I hope improved weather will see continued financial rewards.

Solar my Home were great to deal with, the sales person (Brad) was fantastic.He knew his systems, was prepared to offer alternative system configurations (to suit my budget) and provided detailed information on the Solar Panels and Inverters.Solar my Home (Brad) provided all the information I required without the hard sell.The sales person also didn't tell me things (regarding the panels or inverters) that weren't true when I conducted my own research.(other salesmen lied about the panels they were selling which could be verified with a little internet research).The installer Solar my Home provided (Zoran) was fantastic. He did a wonderful job of the installation (neatly concealing the cabling) and was happy to answer my questions on the day.As a novice to the solar panel industry (although I do have a good technical / engineering background), I couldn't have hoped for a better experience from Solar my Home.I am also more than glad to promote the solar quotes website for the information it provided explaining all the ins and outs of Solar Panel systems.My experience with my retailer (AGL) after getting the solar system installed was terrible (and has taken 6 months to resolve)

I think there are a lot of companies who take advantage of the complexity of the entire process. It is difficult to understand much of the jargon relating to panels and inverters not to mention the rebate system. In the end it's really about trusting the person who comes out to quote.
I would recommend solarmyhome to anyone wanting to install solar. Terrific service, quick, neat and great response from all at solarmyhome.Thanks to all for great job, loving the lower power bills!

The company rep. who came to give us a quote was extremely thorough.  He tailored the best system to our budget, and we were pleasantly surprised that we could afford a larger system, still using quality components. He was also the only rep. to actually go on the roof and measure and inspect for any potential shading etc. He spent over an hour with us going over all the finer details about the different components and their pros and cons.  We were very happy with our dealings with this company.
Very happy with the whole process and your service as well. Just waiting to get connected to the main grid which I believe is always an issue.
Workmen were professional polite cleaned up after themselves and didn't waste time  and explained about the system.
Very courteous and efficient and helpful supplying quote and arranging and performing installation of system. I have no complaint whatsoever and can only speak highly of this business operation.

SolarMyHome were great.  They answered all our questions.  Were reliable.  Salesman, Phone support, Installation and Inspection have all been top quality.The other 2 quotes were more expensive, pushy and we just did not have the same confindence that they would deliver what they promised.

The salesman is the most friendly of all I met. No high pressure tactics, just patience.I think they are the best value for money too.The customer service isn't bad either. Email contacts were replied promptly.

I found the companies suggested by Finn's enabled me to learn more about the solar industry and the equipment available and affordable for me to consider purchasing. I have made the purchase of a system right for our requirements and once our energy company reprograms our meter we look forward to seeing the savings on our electricity bill.

I had my system installed today and it looks great. I would just like to thank Brad for his honest and trustworthy advise.I have listed the reasons that I chose Solar My Home and you will notice that I have not mentioned the price, this is because all of the quotes I got were similar in price. It is the details that matter.I went with Solar My Home for the following reasons :1. They are local and Australian owned.2. The salesman (Brad ) has worked as an installer.3. The company prides itself on using the best quality cables connections and hardware.4. Brad organised my for T.V. antenna to be professionally moved (included in the cost of the system). On the day of the installation. The installers turned up on time and were very polite and courteous. They cleaned up completely on the day. The music that they had playing while they worked wasn't too bad either!

The sales person came out to my home on 2 separate occasions to explain the system fully to me.
